text: Weathered Plate Tunic is a quest reward from The Blood Elves. It was to be rewarded from Compassion.

This is a series of quests which, for the most part, are only loosely linked.

This is a Warrior class-specific quest chain. While the final result is a useful level-appropriate weapon, the real prize comes early on in the form of learning Defensive Stance and a few related skills. There is a similar quest chain for the dwarves, .
Wayward Buzzards were vultures found in the Badlands. These are the birds that come at Rigglefuzz after you have completed Pearl Diving.
The Weapon Rack is located in Angor Fortress of the Badlands.

The Weather-Beaten Fishing Hat Can be found inside rewards from fishing daily quests. This item can be found inside * the Bag of Fishing Treasures (Dalaran) rewarded from completing Marcia Chase's daily fishing quests in Dalaran, * the Bag of Fishing Treasures (Terokkar Forest) from completing the daily quests for Old Man Barlo just outside Shat'trath, * the Bag of Shiny Things from completing the daily quests for Razgar in Orgrimmar, * and the Bag of Shiny Things from completing the daily quests for Catherine Leland in Stormwind. Allows its wearer to cast Fishing Hat Lure, raising the total skill bonus to +80.
The Weapons Vendor sells high-end PvP-oriented weapons, off-hand items and shields to players on the Arena Tournament realms.
The Weapon Containers are located throughout Sunsail Anchorage in Eversong Woods.
Weapon Crates can be found in Blackfathom Deeps and Eversong Woods.
Weapons of Destruction is a quest in the Waygate quest chain in Sholazar Basin.
The Weary Boots Tavern is a tavern located in Ironforge. The members of the Explorers' Guild used to meet here before they built their new Explorers' Guildhall.
Weapon Vellum is created with Inscription (75); taught by trainers.
Weapon Vellum II is created with Inscription (235); taught by trainers.
Weapon Vellum III was created with Inscription (400); taught by Inscription trainers. This produces Weapon Vellum III x2.
We Had It All Along *cough* is a player vs. player achievement earned for winning Arathi Basin by 50 points or less. Required for the meta-achievement Master of Arathi Basin.

We're Not Retreating; We're Advancing in a Different Direction. is a dungeon & raids achievement earned for escaping from the Lich King in the Halls of Reflection on Heroic difficulty in under 6 minutes.
Weathered Crossbow is part of the starting outfit for draenei, human, and Forsaken hunters.
Weakened Reanimated Frost Wyrms are the result of Seeds of Nature's Wrath being used on Reanimated Frost Wyrms in the Dragonblight.
Web Wrap is the web cocoon wrapped around players from either spiders or nerubian creatures found in Azjol-Nerub, Naxxramas, and Icecrown Citadel.
The Weather-Beaten Coin drops from "Good-Boy" Bruce in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
Wazzik's Package is provided by Watcher Wazzik for Enhancing the Stone (Horde) to be delivered to Loramus Thalipedes.
Runed Giants have a chance to become Weakened Giants when Gavrock's Runebreaker is used on them during Free at Last in Grizzly Hills.
The Wayward Water Bucket would be provided as an objective for Fighting the Flames.
Wayward Ancestors are mogu ghosts located in the Terrace of Ten Thunders in the Jade Forest. After Pei-Zhi opened The Tan-Chao, they streamed into it.
Wayward Plainstriders are tallstriders found in western Durotar.
Weakened Blows is a 30 second debuff, caused by Scarlet Fever, Thrash_(Bear_Form), Keg Smash, Crusader Strike, Hammer of the Righteous, Earth Shock and Thunder Clap.
Weaver's Cord of Eternal Autumn can be found inside Cache of Tsulong after defeating Tsulong and inside Box of Fancy Stuff after defeating Lei Shi in Terrace of Endless Spring.
We're Going to Need More Saddles is a collection achievement earned for learning how to summon 150 different mounts on a single character.
We Are Yaungol is a yaungol banner posted in various fire camps in Kun-Lai Summit and Townlong Steppes.

__NOTOC__ .]] Weaver Belmaril is a sin'dorei arcanist. He is a member of the Timewalkers. As a "weaver", he practices chronomancy. Belmaril is present at the Celestial Court on the Timeless Isle investigating the location with the other Timewalkers.
We've Been Dancin is a scenario achievement. Two encampments are selected at random that require assistance of the player. To earn this achievement, the Pandaren must be aided.

__NOTOC__ .]] Weaver Lyra is a night elf embermage. She is a member of the Timewalkers; as a "weaver", she practices chronomancy. She is present on the Timeless Isle, at Celestial Tournament, among the others Timewalkers, to investigate the location.
Weald Stingers are ravager wasps located in Iyun Weald in Gorgrond.
Web-wrapped Soldiers are captured soldiers in a sticky webbing found in the Ashmaul Burial Grounds in Ashran. They spawn a faction-appropriate soldier NPC to assist the player in battle.

Webbed Sac is found at hanging from a ceiling in the upper part of Deathweb Hollow in southeastern Talador. It contains roughly , a Desiccated Orc's Coin Pouch and 20-30 Garrison Resources. A Weapon Enhancement Token will turn in to one of six Follower Weapon Enhancements, which will increase a follower's weapon item level by 3, 6, or 9 points, or directly equip a follower with an item level 615, 630, or 645 weapon. See the See also list for what enhancements this item can create.
Weaponsmith Kaul is a draenei vendor located at the Coliseum of Light in .

This quest was the end point of the legendary ring questline pre-Patch 6.1.0. After the patch it is still available, but is now optional and easy to miss, as the player is automatically directed to Orb of Dominion from Prisoner of the Mind.
A Weathered Bedroll is aTailoring skill-up item. Repairing it will yield either a Wooly Bedroll or a Luxurious Bedroll.

Weapon Crystal is created with Inscription (1); taught by Technique: Weapon Crystal. Required tools: *Virtuoso Inking Set The recipe is sold for 5 x Secret of Draenor Inscription from the inscription vendor at Lunarfall / Frostwall (requires Scribe's Quarters building), and Stormshield / Warspear in Ashran.

The Waywatcher's Boon was looted from a Treasure Chest after defeating Kalazzius the Guileful in Malorne's Refuge in Val'sharah.
Weaponized Rabbot is a rare mechanical rabbit located at Crushcog's Arsenal in New Tinkertown in Dun Morogh.

The Weathered Relic is found in the Feldust Cavern (mouth at ) on the Broken Shore at the very back of the cave after talking to Drak'thul. It is used to attune players to Kosumoth the Hungering. Players will not be able to access the cave until after speaking with Drak'thul the first time and exhausting his gossip text. Return to Drak'thul after picking up the relic to continue the chain.
Weak Lightspawn is a lightspawn located in Netherlight Temple. They function as training dummies for healers.
Weak Point is a Subtlety rogue artifact trait. It is linked to the Shadows of the Uncrowned and Shadow's Whisper traits.
__NOTOC__ Weakened Mosshoof Stag are stags found in Azshara near Orgrimmar Rear Gate.
Wear It With Pride is about collecting a full set of Season 15 armor (including bracer, belt and boots) for one class.
Webbed Victims are cocooned humanoids found inside the Falanaar Tunnels in Falanaar, Suramar. Captured nightborne or withered will be released upon the removal of the cocoon.
Weary Spirits are human ghosts located at Gol Osigr in Drustvar.
Weaver Anaasha is a Zandalari troll located at Grand Bazaar in Dazar'alor.
Webbed Lumberjacks are web cocoon located at the Fernwood Ridge in Tiragarde Sound. Interacting with them releases Algerson Lumberjacks.
Weathered Spyglass can be looted from the object of the same name atop a table in the western part of the Ashvane Encampment in Vol'dun.
The Weathered Satchel drops from Sandfury Assassins at Atul'Aman in Vol'dun.
Wayward Goats are goats located on Tidebreak Summit in Stormsong Valley.
Wayward Spirits are ghosts summoned by Lesser Voidcaller. It dies after several seconds.
Weapons of the Elements is an Enhancement shaman artifact trait. It is linked to the Alpha Wolf (artifact trait), Gathering of the Maelstrom, and Wind Surge traits.

__NOTOC__ The Wayward Fire Elemental is a fire elemental mob found inside the Frostmane Hovel at the southern end of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. It appears to have allied with Grik'nir the Cold and the Frostmane tribe.
Weathered Memento Axe can be obtained from Weathered Axe in Tanaan Jungle.

Webwinder is an untameable, level 7 spider battle pet. It is one of the battle pets of Eric Davidson in Duskwood, along with Darkwidow and Blackfang.
The Weathered Bulwark is left behind when infusing the Enduring Bulwark of the Depths into the Heart Forge.

We Ride Forth is a short story by Robert Brooks released on the official site on November 18, 2020. It features the Four Horsemen resolving to confront the Lich King Bolvar Fordragon over his increasingly militant actions, and serves as a prequel to the Death Rising event.

The Waystone to Oribos in Cocyrus, reactivated by the player during Stand as One in the Shadowlands intro experience, is a First One waystone that is one of the few ways to exit the Maw, returning players and their companions to Oribos. During the Shadowlands intro experience, it is referred to as the Eroded Waystone. The broker Ta'lora notes that the waystone's existence is curious, since the Maw was intended to be an inescapable prison. One possibility is that the infallible First Ones placed it there as a failsafe, though this is a contested theory since it opens the possibility of the Arbiter wrongly assigning souls to the Maw even when she was working correctly. Weldon Barov is a human quest giver located in Lunarfall and can be obtained as a garrison follower for Alliance players. He was previously a a level 60 elite quest giver located inside Scholomance.

Wellspring Lake is a small lake northeast of Darnassus and southeast of the Oracle Glade in Teldrassil. Fed by a natural spring deep within the land of the World Tree, this small lake is drained by the Wellspring River. Previously a favored spot for night elven fishermen, the lake is now the home of corrupted timberlings. The surrounding area is also a dangerous place, as nightsabers and spiders infest the landscape.

A consumable item that adds an imbue to a Blunt weapon that temporarily increases Weapon damage and some also increase Critical strike. Most are created with Blacksmithing. As of Patch 2.3, weightstones last 1 hour. As of Patch 3.0, weightstones can no longer be used on any weapon whose Item Level is higher than 165. Additional info: * Sharpening stone - a Edged weapon imbue (or enhancement) that temporarily increases Weapon damage.

The Westfall Lighthouse sits just off the coast on the far southern edge of Westfall. Outside the lighthouse stands the ghostly Captain Grayson who gives you a few quests that involve killing the Murlocs along the coast. During Children's Week, the Alliance Human Orphan will ask the player to take him here. At some point, James Blackridge, Liam, and Bram Woodring were captured by Jerias Bloodvein of the Bloodsail Buccaneers and his pirate crew at the lighthouse.

Wellspring River comes from a natural spring that lies deep within the great tree Teldrassil. The river flows north from Wellspring Lake and cascades over the edge of Teldrassil in a great waterfall to the sea, far below. Crazed timberlings now patrol the banks of the river, attacking anyone who wanders near.

:This nourishing stew has been made many different ways over the years. In lean times, with the people of Westfall under attack by bandits and gnoll raiders, murloc eyes and buzzard meat were commonly used. We wouldn't recommend it. Westfall Stew is created with Cooking (50); taught by Recipe: Westfall Stew.

The Western Strand is a stretch of coastline in the southwest of Hillsbrad Foothills, complementary to the Eastern Strand further east. The Western Strand is home to the many Torn Fin murlocs who have built small camps along the shore. Andy Murgole patrols the area.

The Weeping Cave is a cave filled with bog beasts and oozes, and also the location of a rare spawn elemental named The Husk. The cave is located in the northeastern area of the Western Plaguelands, just west of the Thondroril River. The Rotting Behemoth and Decaying Horror mobs inside this cave have a low chance to drop Recipe: Greater Nature Protection Potion.

Weegli Blastfuse is an elite goblin found in Zul'Farrak. Weegli is and assists during the Pyramid battle. After the battle, Weegli can be asked to open the gate leading to Chief Ukorz Sandscalp and Ruuzlu using his barrel of explosives. He then runs from Zul'Farrak.

Wednesday morning downtime is a period between 5am and 11am CEST (Paris Time) on a Wednesday morning when Blizzard Entertainment takes down all of the European World of Warcraft realms for weekly maintenance. As a result, no one can play World of Warcraft between 5am and 11am CEST on a Wednesday in Europe.

This article represents the range of weight taken from the vital statistics for various races given in the RPG. These more or less represent the most healthy members of the race, the ones that may become heroes. The base weight represents the lowest possible weight for a healthy individual for the race.
Westfall Woodworkers are humans busy repairing the damage to Sentinel Hill.

The West Garrison is located inside Blackrock Depths, and is accessible from the East Garrison and the Ring of the Law (after defeating the ring challenge). Note that the West Garrison and all areas beyond are locked by a mechanism located in the East Garrison, which requires the Shadowforge Key to operate. The West Garrison is the first area that is always required to pass through to eventually get to the last areas of the instance, the Imperial Seat and the Molten Bridge. It is home to the terrible General Angerforge and numerous Dark Iron dwarf minions. A tunnel leads directly from the garrison to the Manufactory.
Wendigo Fur Cloak drops from Edan the Howler in the Grizzled Den in Dun Morogh.

__NOTOC__ Westfall Deed is a quest starting item that begins Furlbrow's Deed (Classic). This is the deed for a pumpkin farm belonging to Theodore and Verna Furlbrow. It was stolen by a member of the Defias Brotherhood, who was then slain by an adventurer.
The Western Beacon is located in the Great Fissure of Hellfire Peninsula.

Webwood Eggs can be found inside Shadowthread Cave, which lies on the northern end of Shadowglen on Teldrassil. They're guarded by Githyiss the Vile, the broodmother of the webwood spiders. On retail, a Gnarlpine Corruption Totem can be found near them, corrupting the spiders before they even hatch.

The Westwind Lift is a seldom used mechanical device that uses chains and box-like cages to move up and down from the top to the bottom of a cliff on the southern west coast of Howling Fjord just southeast of the top of the Ancient Lift.
Wendy's Torch is provided as an objective for Take No Chances.

Westwind Refugee Camp is a small taunka camp designated as the spot where the villagers of Taunka'le Village would go to after finding out Icemist Village was taken over by the Scourge. What Icemist villagers survived also ended up here. The tauren Emissary Brighthoof currently leads the refugees; the taunka refugees even thinking of her as a village elder.

Westfall Brigade Encampment is an Alliance settlement in Grizzly Hills. At the beginning of the war against the Lich King, the People's Militia joined the Valiance Expedition and came to Northrend as the Westfall Brigade. Under the lead of Gryan Stoutmantle, promoted to the rank of Captain, they have relocated from Sentinel Hill to the Grizzly Hills and built an encampment, in order to fight the undead Scourge. After the fall of the Lich King, the Westfall Brigade went home to rebuild, but the encampment remains as an outpost. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard visited the active outpost during their exploration of Grizzly Hills.
West Point Station is located just to the east of Fizzcrank Airstrip in the Scalding Pools. Twonky is located here.

The Weeping Quarry is a saronite mine used by the Scourge, south of the Shadow Vault in northwestern Icecrown. During the war against the Lich King, the adventurer was sent here by the death knight of the Ebon Blade Keritose Bloodblade to shut down and investigate the mining activity, in order to find out where all the saronite was going to and put an end to this. They first took control of an Eidolon Watcher by using the Eye of Dominion and weaken the defenses for the upcoming assault by banishing the scourge crystals, distracting the plaguehounds, and assassinating the ghoul lookouts. Afterwards, they were sent to bombard the Scourge and steal their documents. Once everything was done, Ker

Westguard Inn is the inn of Westguard Keep, owned and run by Jason Goodhutch and his wife Celeste Goodhutch. The inn is decorated with multiple instances of the ubiquitous portrait of Thousand Needles, in close proximity, seemingly as a commentary on the picture's prevalence throughout inns in the rest of the Azeroth.
The West Point Station Valve can be found in the Geyser Fields in the Borean Tundra.
Westguard Cannonballs can be found just east of Westguard Keep in the Howling Fjord.
The Westspark Workshop is a siege weapon workshop located in southwestern Wintergrasp.
__NOTOC__ Westguard Command Insignia calls forth the Westguard Sergeant, who is a contact for a number of quests.

The Weeping Quarry Map is located in the Weeping Quarry in Icecrown.
The Weeping Quarry Document is located in the Weeping Quarry in Icecrown.

Weslex Quickwrench is a gnome quest giver located at Nesingwary Base Camp in Sholazar Basin. He personally sends adventurers to bring him the material he needs to create The Spirit of Gnomeregan. He can later be found in Ulduar at the Expedition Base Camp informing players of how siege engines operate.
Wendy Breezy is the gnome reporter of the highly esteemed Gnomeregan Gnews Gnetwork.

The Weighted Net is provided by Savinia Loresong and Tylos Dawnrunner for the / daily quest Gormok Wants His Snobolds (Alliance) / (Horde). Use it to capture eight so Gormok the Impaler will have someone to play with.
The Westguard Sergeant is summoned using Westguard Command Insignia, which is only usable in Skorn in the Howling Fjord. He will loan Sergeant's Spyglass when asked.

Weekly quests, or weeklies, are repeatable quests that can be acquired and completed once per week. First introduced with patch 3.1.2 in the combat zone Wintergrasp, they tend to have significantly better rewards than other repeatable quests.

The Westfall Brigade, formerly known as the People's Militia, is primarily a human organization comprised of citizens of Westfall and veteran militiamen that fought back the Defias Brotherhood. They distinguished themselves during the war against the Lich King, the results of the Cataclysm and the third invasion of the Burning Legion.
__NOTOC__ Weeping Gauntlets drop from Bronjahm in the Heroic version of Forge of Souls.
The Well-Stitched Robe is a quest reward from Cloth and Leather Armor.
Weed Fiber Pants are a quest reward from Weed Whacker (quest).

Westfall Mud Pie is a quest reward from Feast or Famine. After consuming it, it gives you the [https://www.wowhead.com/spell=80760/westfall-mud-pie Westfall Mud Pie] buff which lasts two hours and reads, "Your stomach is rumbling..."
Westfall Brigade Footmen are level 75 human guards for the Westfall Brigade Encampment located in the contested territory of the Grizzly Hills.
Well-Preserved Idols are located at the Ruins of Ammon in Uldum.
Westfall & Duskwood Quests is an alliance-only quest achievement earned by completing Westfall and Duskwood storylines.
Wellspring Hovel is a small hamlet located in Teldrassil on the main road between Darnassus and Dolanaar.

Western Plaguelands is a contested level 35-40 zone in north-central Lordaeron on the Eastern Kingdoms. Players are led here from either the Cape of Stranglethorn or the Hinterlands. The progress of the storyline is tracked in the achievement Western Plaguelands Quests. Once players have concluded the storyline, their next stop is just across the Thondroril River in Eastern Plaguelands to start the Fiona's Caravan chain in the Eastern Plaguelands storyline.
Wendigo Leggings are a quest reward from Pilfered Supplies (quest).
This is a page listing loot to be found in Well of Eternity. For information about the instance itself, see Well of Eternity.

The Wellson Shipyard was an Alliance shipyard on the Tol Barad Peninsula. The workers have been killed by an unknown force and now wander the shipyard as restless spirits. The shipyard is heavily defended by several guard towers and lies beneath Farson Hold. There are a number of civilian buildings flanking the dry-docks, and it has stone docks for ships. The undead here are hostile to the Alliance and Horde forces on Tol Barad, and in fact make efforts to reinforce their position with mysterious, ghostly supplies being ferried in from out to sea.
Well Water is sold by at Furlbrow's Pumpkin Patch after the player helps her out in Feast or Famine.

West Plain Drifters are homeless people found in various locations around Westfall. During the Legion Invasions, they could be found injured or being cornered by demons. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion.
Well Crafted Leather Britches is a quest reward from Deep Roots (quest).
The quest Well Armed is part of the Firelands Invasion. This is a breadcrumb quest leading you back to Ricket and Damek Bloombeard.
The Well of Tranquility is one of three fonts within the tree Tal'doren, and its waters sooth the beast of a worgen. It is involved in the quest Neither Human Nor Beast.
The Well of Balance is one of three fonts within the tree Tal'doren, and its waters aid a worgen's soul to master the beast within. It is involved in the quest Neither Human Nor Beast.

The Well of Fury is one of three fonts within the tree Tal'doren. The blessing from the Well of Fury allows the worgen to combine the wisdom of his race with Goldrinn's raw fury, which the worgen's beast nature draws from. It is involved in the quest Neither Human Nor Beast.
Wei Palerage is a pandaren hermit found at the Forlorn Hut aiding the survivors of the Skyseeker crash on the Wandering Isle.
Westfall Brigade Guards were human guards found at Sentinel Hill in Westfall. They later became Sentinel Hill Guards. However, they still appear when Horde are in the area.
Weisheng is a mogu found in the Hall of Kings in the Throne of Thunder.
Weevil is a rare beetle located inside the yeti cave in Hillsbrad Foothills.
Weighed Down was a player vs. player achievement earned for killing an enemy carrying your mine cart before they leave your base in Deepwind Gorge.
Weeping Widows are bone spiders found in the Widow's Wail in the Jade Forest.
Wei Blacksoil is a pandaren located at Stoneplow in Valley of the Four Winds.
Welcome to Draenor is a quest achievement earned for completing the Assault on the Dark Portal, concluding with The Home Stretch.
Wei Suremend is a pandaren first aid trainer found in Warspear Barracks in Warspear on Ashran.
Well-Oiled Shamanic Talismans are pickpocketed from humanoids all across Pandaria.
Wet Sand is obtained from a pile of wet sand in Tanaris during Secrets in the Oasis.
__NOTOC__ Weebomination has a chance to drop from the Big Bag of Pet Supplies.
Two Westguard Bombardiers can be found in the living quarters of Westguard Keep.
Weighted Chopping Axe is a common Draenor Clans archaeology artifact, created from 45 Draenor Clans Archaeology Fragments. One Draenor Clan Orator Cane may be used to solve this artifact.
Wellspring is a Restoration shaman talent. It is an exclusive choice node with Deeply Rooted Elements.
Weighty Brul Totems are looted from treasure chests in the Broken Isles.

Well of the Forgotten is the first area in the Forgotten Crypt. The altar and the gate have been added in Legion. Warlocks get to come here for The Grimoire of the First Necrolyte in order to unlock the hidden skin for Ulthalesh, the Deadwind Harvester.
Weeping Bluffs is a series of bluffs with pools of water flowing onto the next. The bluffs are found in northwestern Stormheim. This is the area the Skyfire came to a crashing end.
The Well-Wrapped Package is provided as an objective for Ari's Package.
The Well-Cut Maelstrom Sapphire is obtained after cutting the gem already placed in Tiffany's Carving Machine in Cartier & Co. Fine Jewelry in Dalaran.
__NOTOC__ The Well-Fed Lion Seal is a lion seal that appears in Challiane's Terrace, on the coast south of the Ruined Sanctum, or in a cave on a small isle on the western coast of Azsuna.
The Well-Tailored Robes are obtained after defeating Raethas Dawnseer at Sable Ridge in Azshara.
